title: Never Alone
story:
A young girl once got lost in a large shopping mall.

She walked quickly through crowded halls.

Every direction looked the same.

Fear slowly filled her heart.

She called out for her parents, but no one heard her.

She sat down near a wall and began to cry.

A security guard noticed her.

He came closer and gently asked her name.

Then he spoke into his radio.

“Child found. Parents are being contacted.”

Within minutes, her parents arrived.

She ran into their arms.

She said, “I thought I was alone.”

Her father replied, “You were never alone. We were always looking for you.”

In life, we often feel lost.

In busy seasons.

In silent nights.

In painful moments.

We think God is far away.

But no place is outside His reach.

Not the highest place.

Not the deepest valley.

Not darkness.

Not fear.

He is always there.

Guiding.

Watching.

Holding us close.
life_lesson:
There is nowhere you can go where God is not with you.

You are never alone.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for always being with me.

Even when I feel lost or alone, You are near.

Help me to remember that nothing can separate me from Your presence.

Guide me in every moment of my life.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you ever felt completely alone?

Do you believe God is with you even in your darkest moments?

How can you rest in His presence today?
verse:
Where can I go from Your Spirit?
Where can I flee from Your presence?
If I go up to the heavens, You are there.
If I make my bed in the depths, You are there.
